page: Google Cloud Platform t2d-standard-48 is a general-purpose virtual machine designed around dedicated compute resources. It features 48 dedicated physical cores mapped to 48 vCPUs without simultaneous multithreading (1 thread per core). Powered by an AMD EPYC 7B13 processor built on the x86_64 architecture, the instance incorporates 32 KB of L1 data cache, 0.5 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache per core cluster. Memory is provisioned at 192 GB, establishing a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The instance includes no bundled local storage and does not feature dedicated GPU acceleration.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong parallel compute capabilities. In stress-ng testing, multi-core CPU throughput reached 129,469.07, placing it in the top 10% tier, supported by a strong single-core result of 2,745.47. The instance scored 17,024.0 on Geekbench multi-core and achieved elevated metrics in PassMark CPU extended instructions (75,279.31) and software compilation using Clang (46,755.0). Cached memory bandwidth reached 5,702.82 GB/sec, while uncached read and write throughput recorded 144.54 GB/sec and 67.36 GB/sec respectively, reflecting average baseline DRAM throughput.

The 1:1 physical core allocation eliminates noisy-neighbor contention from hyperthreading, yielding consistent CPU throughput and strong performance in in-memory workloads, evidenced by 85.78 million Redis SET operations per second and a PassMark database score of 24,995.07. However, the lack of local NVMe storage requires external persistent storage solutions for stateful tasks. Large-scale CPU inference performance also shows limitations, with 70B parameter models achieving 2.55 tokens/sec for text generation. GCP t2d-standard-48 is well aligned for large microservices deployments, CI/CD compilation pipelines, distributed databases, and high-concurrency web application backends.
description: Google Cloud Platform t2d-standard-48 is a general-purpose instance providing 48 dedicated physical cores and 48 vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 7B13 x86_64 processor. Configured with 192 GB of memory, it delivers a balanced 4.0 GB per vCPU ratio without simultaneous multithreading. It includes no bundled local disks or GPU accelerators. In benchmarks, the instance delivers top-tier multi-core compute scaling, scoring 129,469.07 in stress-ng and 17,024.0 in Geekbench multi-core, alongside 85.78 million operations per second in Redis SET tests. Large-block memory transfers and large model LLM text generation represent modest tradeoffs, and external persistent storage must be attached. With non-hyperthreaded physical cores delivering predictable execution, t2d-standard-48 fits large-scale code compilation, distributed databases, high-throughput web serving, and containerized enterprise services.
